model: correlated Gaussian scalar field threshold-percolation; exploratory sensitivity, not original manuscript reproduction
seed_method: numpy.random.SeedSequence(base_seed).spawn(8); each child generates one uint32 seed
boundary: periodic 3N x 3N spectral field, central N x N crop, recenter and population-standardize each crop
confidence_intervals: Wilson 95% binomial intervals conditional on independent simulated maps
